remarks: Discover the possibilities of spacious townhome living in the gated Shady Hollow community, conveniently located near the Orange and Tustin borders. This four-bedroom, two-and-one-half-bath residence offers a versatile floor plan, and inviting landscaped surroundings. From the moment you enter, soaring cathedral ceilings and abundant natural light create an open, welcoming atmosphere. Living and dining areas invite gatherings, while a separate family room adds flexibility. The practical layout adapts to a variety of needs.
